product.olivetti-m4-p100.summary: The 100 MHz M4-P in the Tin Box case of the EDO memory platform.
product.olivetti-m4-p100.history: Olivetti documented the professional M4-Pxx range on a platform shared with the PCS 51xx and 61xx.
product.olivetti-m4-p100.architecture: The case determines how many cards can be installed. The Tin Box riser has 2 ISA, 2 PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-m4-p100.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p100.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p100.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 16
product.olivetti-m4-p100.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.21.
